evidence.summary: The post-analysis generation guard refuses stale publication.

reproduction.instructions: Issue successive edits while analysis is in flight; assert that old snapshots are discarded and the current generation alone remains authoritative.

summary: Superseded analyses are now prevented from publishing current events or evidence by generation checks, but ReferenceCompiler frontend work remains synchronous and cannot be interrupted. Forge can cancel/coalesce queued work and discard stale provider results; true frontend cancellation remains open.

workaround.description: Post-analysis generation guard plus Forge queued-job coalescing and stale-result suppression.
